extract_post_relax_config: extract post-relaxation filtering parameters like energy cutoff and lattice tolerance from a workflow config dictionary
filter_and_deduplicate_single_dataset: filter and deduplicate a single parquet dataset of ML-relaxed crystal structures by energy, density, and connectivity
orchestrate_parallel_filtering: submit parallel SLURM jobs to filter and deduplicate multiple crystal structure datasets across a directory
review_filtering_workflow: review the post-relaxation filtering workflow that validates connectivity, applies density cutoffs, and deduplicates structures using pymatgen
refactor_deduplication_params: refactor the filter and deduplicate function to adjust lattice tolerance, site tolerance, and angle tolerance for structure matching
